audit.protocol: Full CAUCAFall development audit, subjects 1-10; already-seen data; fresh inference with frozen latest V3 configuration

provenance.protocol: Full CAUCAFall development audit, subjects 1-10; already-seen data; fresh inference with frozen latest V3 configuration
provenance.configuration:
# V3 development: rotation inference plus a bent-knee check on short-trunk evidence.
video:
  source: '0'
  frame_skip: 0
  resize:
    mode: longest_side
    longest_side: 960
    letterbox_size: null
    allow_upscale: false
  loop: false
fall:
  enabled: true
  min_fps: 15.0
  posture:
    trunk_angle_min_deg: 45.0
    keypoint_spread_y_max: 0.45
    hip_ankle_dy_max: 0.34
    hip_knee_dy_max: 0.12
    trunk_length_max: 0.28
    seated_knee_angle_max_deg: 135.0
    seated_spread_y_min: 0.59
    upright_aspect_ratio_min: 1.4
    upright_trunk_angle_max_deg: 45.0
    min_orientation_votes: 1
    min_limb_votes: 1
    min_available_indicators: 3
  timing:
    require_current_lying_for_alert: true
    persistence_s: 3.0
    min_lying_fraction: 0.7
    min_known_fraction: 0.5
    grace_s: 0.5
    falling_timeout_s: 1.5
    max_unknown_s: 3.0
    recover_s: 1.5
    recovered_hold_s: 1.0
    cooldown_s: 30.0
    velocity_window_s: 0.5
    falling_velocity: null
pose:
  model: yolo11n-pose.pt
  models_dir: models
  device: auto
  conf: 0.25
  keypoint_conf: 0.5
  imgsz: 640
  rotations:
  - -90
  - 90
  merge_iou: 0.5
  rotation_conf: 0.5
tracking:
  window_s: 3.0
  track_activation_threshold: 0.25
  lost_track_buffer: 30
  minimum_matching_threshold: 0.95
  minimum_consecutive_frames: 1
  prune_after_s: 5.0
  max_gap_s: 0.2

alarm_localization.protocol: Auxiliary spatial check at each emitted alarm; does not establish action correctness

profile_comparison.protocol: Decision-profile comparison on identical fresh rotation-inference detections; development data
